WITH selected_users AS
(
    SELECT
        user_id,
        created_at
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
),
first_events AS
(
    SELECT
        e.user_id,
        min(e.timestamp) AS first_event_time
    FROM events AS e
    ASOF INNER JOIN selected_users AS u
        ON e.user_id = u.user_id
       AND e.timestamp >= u.created_at
    GROUP BY e.user_id
)
SELECT
    u.user_id,
    f.first_event_time
FROM selected_users AS u
LEFT JOIN first_events AS f
    ON u.user_id = f.user_id
ORDER BY u.user_id ASC;
